 Naz Reid flirts with double-double in Saturday's win over Heat 
 by Chris Schommer | Hornets Correspondent | Sun, Oct 25th 2026, 8:52am EDT 
 Naz Reid flirted with a double-double for the Hornets Saturday night, grabbing nine rebounds and scoring 23 points (9-16 FG, 5-8 3PT) while also blocking two shots in a 115-110 win over the Heat. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Reid has been impactful on both ends of the floor to begin the season, grabbing six or more rebounds and scoring 17 or more points in each of the first three contests. The 27-year-old offers fantasy managers a reliable option as part of a revamped Hornets starting five early on, averaging 20.0 points and 8.7 rebounds per game while carrying a 25.6% usage rate so far this season.
